finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell sewing-supplies organizer: a 3-compartment full-depth bin for small notions (buttons, pins, bobbins), a 2-compartment half-depth tray for everyday tools, and a deep open bin for scissors/rotary cutters and fabric scraps. Open faces capped and joints bolted. Dressed with tape measure, tweezers and marking pencil to show the use. Verified with check_build (no issues, mesh clear) and viewed from above and at eye level.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
